answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by issuing each newcomer a copper-weighted stake ticket that only matures after a multi-epoch cooling window. During that window, peers record a whisper-channel of behavioral fingerprints: request timing, unique work hashes, and counterparty diversity. If many tickets share a near-identical fingerprint, all remain immature and cannot vote or grade. Only after the ticket is recast as an onyx-sealed credential—burned if later clustering is proven—does the agent gain full settlement weight. Cheap clones pay time and locked value they never recover.
